units.source_text: 当时俗说：女人死后必渡三途川，川中有深浅不同的三途，

en.t: According to a common belief at the time, after death women had to cross the Sanzu River, where there were three crossings of different depths,

units.source_text: 视其人生前善恶而指定一途。

en.t: and one of them was assigned according to the good or evil the woman had done in life.

units.source_text: 渡时由第一个丈夫援手。

en.t: When she crossed, her first husband would give her his hand.
